{{MissingInfo|1|enva}} {{AnimePokémonInfobox |type1=Normal |trainername=Goh |pokemonname=Greedent |jtrainername=ゴウ |jpokemonname=ヨクバリス |tmtrainername=Go |tmpokemonname=Yokubarisu |image=[[File:Goh Greedent.png|250px]] |caption=Goh's Greedent |prevonum=819 |evo1num=820 |epnum=JN013 |epname=The Climb to Be the Very Best! |evolution=1 |firstevoep=JN047 |firstevoname=Crowning the Chow Crusher! |firststagename=Skwovet |secondstagename=Greedent |numeps1=34 |location=[[Wyndon]] |current=[[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]] |gender=Unknown |ability=Unknown |java1=[[Noriaki Kanze]] |enva1=[[Michele Knotz]] |java2=[[Noriaki Kanze]] |enva2=Unknown }} '''Goh's Greedent''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのヨクバリス''' ''Go's Yokubarisu'') is the second {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Galar]] [[region]], and his twenty-fourth overall. ==History== ==={{aniseries|JN}}=== [[File:JN047.png|thumb|250px|left|Skwovet in the Pokémon Grand Eating Contest]] In ''[[JN013|The Climb to Be the Very Best!]]'', Goh encountered {{p|Greedent}} as a {{p|Skwovet}} while in [[Wyndon]]. He and {{Ash}} were enjoying scones when he noticed Skwovet eating one of Ash's. Upon seeing this, Goh immediately threw a {{i|Poké Ball}} and {{pkmn2|caught}} it. In ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', panic erupted amongst Goh's Pokémon at [[Cerise Laboratory]] when there was a food shortage. Working with {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Cubone}}, Skwovet enlisted {{TP|Goh|Golurk}} to stop the other Pokémon from fighting. Instead, this resulted in Golurk's seal falling off, which caused Golurk to go berserk. Skwovet helped put the seal back on before helping to protect the three {{p|Cascoon}} from the flood caused by Golurk's rampage, allowing them to evolve into {{DL|List of Goh's Pokémon|Dustox}}. The next day, Skwovet was revealed to be the culprit behind the shortage, as it had been taking the food and storing it in a cave in secret. In ''[[JN047|Crowning the Chow Crusher!]]'', Goh entered Skwovet in the [[Pokémon Grand Eating Contest]]. It reached the top three, going up against a {{p|Blaziken}} and {{TP|James|Morpeko}}. After Blaziken refused to eat the {{p|Torchic}}-shaped {{wp|manjū}} and Morpeko sent {{TRT}} blasting off, Skwovet [[Evolution|evolved]] into Greedent, allowing it to eat enough food to win the competition. In ''[[JN070|Take My Thief! Please!]]'', Greedent had another run-in with its rival Morpeko when it arrived at Cerise Laboratory. The two ended up fighting over the food of the other Pokémon residing in Cerise Park. The two are pacified by {{TP|Goh|Raichu}} delivering them a large amount of {{Berries}}. In ''[[JN101|A One-Stick Wonder!]]'', Goh used Greedent to train a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Thwackey}} alongside Ash's Pokémon. Goh used Greedent's {{m|Bullet Seed}} move so that Thwackey could hit it with his branch. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Greedent attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure. After that, it posed for a group photo with Goh, Ash, and the others. {{-}} ==Personality and characteristics== [[File:Goh and Greedent.png|thumb|left|250px|Greedent and Goh]] [[File:James Morpeko and Goh Greedent.png|thumb|250px|Greedent and its rival {{TP|James|Morpeko}}]] Typical of its species, Greedent is gluttonous and likes to store food, such as in ''[[JN023|Panic in the Park!]]'', where it, as a {{p|Skwovet}}, stored all of the food at [[Cerise Laboratory]]. Its gluttony can cause it to be selfish and shortsighted, as it ended up storing the food of the other Pokémon with little concern for the consequences. Even after this caused a hunger panic, it didn't seem to realize it should give back the food and even continued to store food after the problem was solved. However, this gluttony can cause determination to spark in the [[Pokémon category|Greedy Pokémon]], as shown when it kept eating the {{p|Torchic}} {{wp|manjū}} and [[Evolution|evolved]] during the [[Pokémon Grand Eating Contest]]. At the Laboratory, Greedent is part of the group of small Pokémon that formed near {{TP|Goh|Golurk}}. It even helped the rest of the group put the Automaton Pokémon's seal back on its chest to stop its rampage.
